items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 94:1
items.html: (To the question) What is "enslaved to Hesed and Gevura"? The aspect of the revealed Hassadim that ZA receives from the two crowns of Aba and Ima does not make him a completely free man, since he is enslaved to the coupling of Hesed and Gevura, which draw the illumination of Hochma, and then the external ones have no grip in his revealed NHY. However, without this coupling, there is fear of the external ones, that they will grip his NHY, as is known. However, the aspect of the KHB that ZA receives from the inheritance of Aba and Ima makes him a completely free man, for even without the coupling of Hesed and Gevura, the external ones have no grip in these lights, for they are corrected in the MEM of the Tzelem, in which no judgment and restriction has any grip, being the aspect of the GAR of Bina, as is known. (Item 60).
